title: Bookings
description: Keep track of the help you've booked and the tasks you're helping with.

needsAction.title: Nothing needs your action
needsAction.body: Bookings that need a payment, check-in, or approval will appear here.

upcoming.title: No upcoming bookings
upcoming.body: Post a task to get help, or find a task you can help with. Your bookings will appear here.

past.title: Nothing has finished yet
past.body: Completed and canceled bookings will appear here.

nextStep.pay: Pay to confirm. The hold ends {relative}.
nextStep.review_work: Review the work by {date}, or it's approved automatically.
nextStep.on_my_way: Tap "On my way" when you leave. It starts at {time}.
nextStep.check_in: Tap "I'm here" when you arrive. It starts at {time}.
